name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TLWEGGH15.affine_relation_kills_linear_pad
title: An affine relation among gated rows removes every term linear in them, wide error included
statement: For a linear map L between modules over a commutative ring, vectors c_z, coefficients alpha_z with sum alpha_z = 1 and sum alpha_z c_z = 0, a mask m and noise e_z: sum alpha_z (m + L(c_z) + e_z) = m + sum alpha_z e_z.
